crossRefs.note: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

translations.web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
